privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: We're a small business and we use your data for one thing: taking you fishing. Here's exactly what we keep and why, no fine print.

sections.title: Who is responsible for your data
sections.body: Sal y Sol Sportfishing, operating out of Marina La Costa, Rangel y Navarro, La Paz, Baja California Sur, Mexico. You can reach us on WhatsApp at the number shown on this site.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: When you book we ask for your name, phone and email, along with the date, time and number of guests for your trip. When you accept the liability waiver we also store your name, the date and time of acceptance and your IP address, as proof of that agreement.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: To run your trip: confirming your booking, assigning a captain and boat, and reaching you before departure. Also to keep the waiver on record. We don't use it for advertising and we won't flood your inbox.

sections.title: Payment data
sections.body: Your card details NEVER pass through our servers and we can't see them. Payments are processed by Stripe, which is PCI DSS compliant. We only store the amount, the currency and a transaction reference.

sections.title: Who we share it with
sections.body: Only who your trip requires: the assigned captain gets your name, phone and departure details. We use Stripe for payments and email and WhatsApp services to confirm. We don't sell or hand over your data to third parties.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: Bookings are kept as a record of the operation. Checkouts left unpaid are deleted automatically after 30 days.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask us to access your data, correct it if it's wrong, delete it or object to its use. Message us on WhatsApp or email us from the address you booked with and we'll sort it out — no special form needed.

nav.whatsappMessage: Hi! I'd like to book a fishing tour. Can you help me?

hero.headlineEnd: in the Bay of La Paz
hero.subtext: We're local captains. We head out every day before sunrise from Marina La Costa, on our own boats, with the gear ready. All you have to do is show up.

about.headline: We're not an agency. We're the ones taking you out
about.body1: No middlemen, no offices here. Whoever answers the WhatsApp is the same person tying up the boat before dawn, and the owners run trips as captains too. We've known this bay since we were kids and we still fish it on the days we aren't taking guests out.
about.body2: Every trip is yours alone — the boat is never shared with strangers. First time fishing? Don't worry, the captain will show you how to cast and how to fight the fish. And if something didn't go the way you hoped, tell us straight. That's how we sort things out around here.
about.photoHint: Photo of the captains at the dock, ideally at sunrise and unposed

fleet.headline: Our boats
fleet.intro: They're ours, we look after them ourselves and we know them inside out. We'll put you on whichever one suits your group — if there are only a few of you we won't charge you extra for a bigger boat.
fleet.note: Want more photos of one of them? Ask on WhatsApp and we'll send them over.

included.licenseBody: In Mexico every person fishing on board needs their own CONAPESCA licence. We don't include it in the price because it's a personal permit, but you can get it online in a few minutes and it's inexpensive. If that's a hassle, tell us and we'll help you sort it before your trip.
included.catchBody: What you land is yours to take home. Species like marlin and sailfish are reserved for sport fishing and have a daily limit per angler — when one comes up, the usual thing is a quick photo and back in the water. The captain will tell you what's fair game, without lecturing you.

groups.headline: More than 6 of you?
groups.body: One panga holds up to 6. If there are more of you, no problem: we'll line up two or three boats so you all leave at the same time and can see each other out on the water. Message us and we'll put it together with you.

items.q: What is included in the trip?
items.a: Full fishing gear and a cooler with ice. Bait, fishing licence, food and drinks are not included.

items.q: How many people fit on the boat?
items.a: We have two classes: small for up to 3 guests and large for up to 6. The whole boat is yours, never shared. There is no minimum group size and no age restriction.

items.q: What time do we leave and how long is the trip?
items.a: You choose your departure time between 5:00 and 7:00 am when you book. The trip lasts 6 to 8 hours.
At Marina La Costa, Rangel y Navarro, La Paz, BCS, next to Restaurant Marina La Costa. You make your own way to the meeting point.
Pay 100% online, or leave a 30% deposit online and settle the remaining 70% in cash. We accept pesos and dollars.

items.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
items.a: If the captain decides conditions are not safe, we cancel and refund 100% of what you paid.

items.q: Can I change my booking date?
items.a: Yes, with at least 48 hours notice. We'll move you to the next available slot. With less notice it gets tricky because the captain and boat are already committed, but talk to us and we'll see what we can do.

items.q: Do I need a fishing licence?
items.a: Yes, everyone fishing on board needs their own CONAPESCA licence. It isn't included in the price because it's a personal permit, but you can get it online in a few minutes. If that's a hassle, message us and we'll help you before the trip.

items.q: Can I keep what I catch?
items.a: Of course, it's yours. Bring a cooler if you want to take it home properly. One thing: marlin and sailfish are reserved for sport fishing and have a daily limit per angler, so the usual thing is a photo and back in the water. The captain will guide you.

items.q: I've never fished. Am I going to embarrass myself?
items.a: Not at all, and you wouldn't be the first. The captain will show you how to cast and how to fight the fish. We've taken out people who had never set foot on a boat and they went home with their catch.
It happens, especially when the water is choppy. If you're prone to it, take a tablet before boarding, not after. And tell the captain — he knows how to shape the trip so you have a better time.

items.q: There are more than 6 of us. What do we do?
items.a: We line up several boats so you all leave at the same time and can see each other on the water. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll put it together with you.

items.q: What if I can't make it and it isn't the weather?
items.a: We'll be straight with you: bad weather is the only case with a refund. If you can't come, tell us as early as you can — with 48 hours notice we'll move your date, no problem. We'd rather find you another day than keep your money.

page.title: Liability waiver
page.intro: This document describes the risks of the activity and the terms you accept when booking a sport fishing tour with Sal y Sol Sportfishing. By ticking the box at checkout you declare that you have read it and agree to it.

sections.title: 1. Nature of the activity
sections.body: Sport fishing takes place in open water aboard small boats and carries risks inherent to the activity: swell, changing weather, boat motion, use of hooks and fishing gear, sun exposure and contact with marine species. You take part with full knowledge of these risks and of your own free will.

sections.title: 2. Participant obligations
sections.body: You agree to follow the captain's instructions at all times, to wear a life jacket whenever he asks, and not to board under the influence of alcohol or any substance that impairs your reflexes. The captain may refuse boarding or return to port if he considers your conduct puts anyone aboard at risk, with no right to a refund.

sections.title: 3. Minors
sections.body: There is no age restriction, but minors travel under the responsibility and constant supervision of the adult who made the booking.

sections.title: 4. Scope of the waiver
sections.body: You release Sal y Sol Sportfishing, its captains, crew and boats from liability for injury, loss, damage or misplacement of personal belongings occurring during the tour and not caused by their proven negligence. This waiver does not limit any rights granted to you by law that cannot be waived.

sections.title: 5. Safety and weather cancellation
sections.body: The final decision on sailing conditions rests with the captain. If he determines it is not safe to sail, the tour is cancelled and you are refunded 100% of what you paid. The boats carry current insurance.

sections.title: 6. Data we record
sections.body: When you accept, we store your name, the date and time of acceptance and your IP address as proof of this agreement. Your contact details are used solely to coordinate your trip.
